summary_en: Cross Plus authorized repurchase of up to 250,000 shares (3.35% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 350 million yen through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 from September 7 to November 30, 2026, citing responsive capital policy execution and shareholder returns amid current valuation and capital efficiency considerations.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Cross Plus Inc. announced on September 4, 2026 that its Board of Directors authorized the repurchase of treasury stock under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and Article 37 of the company's Articles of Incorporation. The company will acquire up to 250,000 shares at a maximum total outlay of 350 million yen through market purchases, including off-auction transactions via ToSTNeT-3, during the period from September 7 to November 30, 2026. This represents 3.4% of issued shares excluding treasury stock (7,464,279 shares as of July 31, 2026).

The company cited responsive execution of capital policy in response to changes in the business environment and enhancement of shareholder returns as the primary reasons for the repurchase. Management stated it has comprehensively considered the current stock price level and capital efficiency metrics in reaching this decision. The company noted that market conditions may result in partial or full non-execution of the repurchase.

Regarding utilization of repurchased shares, the company indicated it will consider deployment toward growth investments, including as consideration in M&A transactions, as well as potential cancellation. The company stated it would provide additional notice if and when it decides to cancel treasury stock.
